title: MFA Invalid Code - Urgent Login Block

customer_profile.name: Amina Hassan
customer_profile.opening_message: I’m locked out of my account. The MFA code keeps saying 'invalid' even though I’m typing it right. I have a deadline in 30 minutes — please help.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Will calm down if agent acknowledges urgency and provides a clear step-by-step plan quickly
customer_profile.personality_notes: Cooperative but stressed; wants fast progress and clear guidance.

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge urgency and reassure the customer you will help
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Acknowledge the urgency and reassure them you will help right away.

checkpoints.description: Confirm whether MFA is via SMS or authenticator app
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Confirm whether they use SMS OTP or an authenticator app.

checkpoints.description: Ask for safe context (device type, browser/app, when it started, exact error text)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask safe diagnostic questions (device, browser/app, start time, exact error text).

checkpoints.description: Check and fix time sync (set device time to automatic) then retry once
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Suggest time sync (set device time to automatic) as a common MFA fix, then retry once.

checkpoints.description: If still failing, guide alternate safe options (backup codes, resend, different device/browser)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Provide alternate safe options (backup codes if allowed, resend, different device/browser).

checkpoints.description: Escalate to identity team with timestamp, environment details, and steps already tried
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Escalate with complete context (timestamp, environment, steps tried) if unresolved.

common_mistakes_to_watch: Repeating generic steps without gathering new info

scenario_context: Customer uses MFA via authenticator app. This issue is caused by device time drift. Policy: never request OTP codes. Customer is anxious but cooperative.
